action: Use the microphone in the top bar field or the composer
user_goal: I want to ask by speaking instead of typing
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, today Nov 14)

Before the tap, define window.webkitSpeechRecognition as a class whose start() calls this.onresult({ results: [[{ transcript }]] }) then this.onend() with the transcript "Can I afford ¥4,000 tonight?"
steps: Tap the mic button beside the Ask field in the top bar (the phone bar at 375px)
expected: The Ask panel opens as an overlay on Home at 1100px, and the full Ask page opens at /canvas#ask at 375px
The composer has "Can I afford ¥4,000 tonight?" with the cursor at the end
Nothing is sent: no turn appears until Ask or Enter
The mic button is 44px tall at 375px

action: Tap the microphone in a browser with no speech recognition
user_goal: I want to still be able to type my question
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, today Nov 14)
A browser without speech recognition (Firefox, or delete window.webkitSpeechRecognition and window.SpeechRecognition before the tap)
steps: Tap the mic button in the top bar
expected: The bar says "This browser doesn’t offer speech recognition. Type your question below."
The Ask field still opens Ask and typing a character on it still starts a question

action: Fill the bill form by voice in Japanese
user_goal: I want to add rent by saying it
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, today Nov 14)
Home → + Add → A bill open at 375px and 1440px
Before the tap, define window.webkitSpeechRecognition as a class whose start() calls this.onresult({ results: [[{ transcript }]] }) then this.onend() with the transcript "来月の家賃12万円、27日"
expected: Name 家賃, Amount 120000, Due date Dec 27
The filled fields are outlined until edited and "Heard: “来月の家賃12万円、27日”" shows
Nothing is saved until Add bill is tapped

action: Say dollars on a yen bill form
user_goal: I want a wrong currency never to be filled in as yen
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, today Nov 14)

Before the tap, set both window.SpeechRecognition and window.webkitSpeechRecognition to a fake recognizer. In start(), queue a microtask that calls onresult with results [[{ transcript: "fifty dollars" }]], then calls onend
expected: Exactly one note reads "You said dollars; this field takes yen."

action: Post to voice fill from another site
user_goal: a stranger's page must not use the route
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, today Nov 14)
A session cookie for the household
steps: POST /api/voice-fill with a foreign Origin header
expected: The foreign Origin is refused with 403 and no model call is made

action: Fill a card charge by real speech
user_goal: I want to log a charge by saying it

+ Add → A card charge open, in Chrome or Safari with a microphone
steps: Tap Fill by voice and say "3,800 yen at the noodle place on Card B yesterday"
